description: This file contains the implementation of an API handler for updating OAuth client details, including permission checks, status updates, notifications, and data building functions.

methods.name: toNullableString
methods.description: Converts a string or null/undefined to null if undefined, otherwise returns the string.

methods.name: hasAnyFieldsChanged
methods.description: Checks if any of the provided fields have changed (are not undefined).

methods.name: triggersReapprovalForOwnerEdit
methods.description: Determines if re-approval is needed when an owner edits certain client fields.

methods.name: computeNextStatus
methods.description: Calculates the next OAuth client status based on requested status and re-approval triggers.

methods.name: notifyOwnerAboutAdminReview
methods.description: Sends notification emails to the owner about the admin's review decision on OAuth client approval or rejection.

methods.name: buildUpdateClientUpdateData
methods.description: Builds the data object for updating OAuth client, including handling of status and rejection reason.
